scope: G3開催 S級 only, 5-9 riders; no F1 or other grades
first_probability_definition: G3-only V1 full-plus-line G3 independent win probability q, no betting odds
fit_target: Actual second place conditional on actual first place. All other riders in the race compete for second.
equation: P(j|i)=q_j^gamma exp(A I(j immediately behind i in same line)+B I(j ahead of i in same line)+C I(j >=2 places behind i in same line)+D I(j is second rider of any >=2 rider line)+E I(j is third or later rider of any line)+F I(j is solo)) / sum_{h!=i} same weights(h)
variables_are_overlapping_by_design: Position indicators are mutually exclusive; candidate role dummies provide separate additive effects. Do not introduce redundant same_line term alongside directed position indicators.
yearly_first_probability_fit: For each year 2023 onward, G3 data from strictly prior years; 2022 in-sample first probabilities retained for empirical census only, not for second-law fit
selection_note: Selected from candidate model families using 2025 validation log-loss before looking at 2026H1 evaluation. The added role terms have only a small improvement vs directed positions alone in 2026H1, CI spans zero. Do not claim independent robust role benefit.
pre_race_joint: For every distinct ordered (i,j), P(first=i,second=j)=q_i * P(second=j | first=i). Sum over all other possible winners for marginal second probabilities.
notes: All historical G3 racer entries and published lines were downloaded retrospectively in 2026, not proven to be exact original pre-race feature snapshots.
2022 is reserved as first-model warmup and empirical observation, 2023 onward produces G3 first probabilities from prior calendar years only.
2026H1 conditional second evaluation knows actual first-place rider; this is not a pre-race exacta accuracy metric.
1083 evaluation races are below the Benter 1994 3198-race example and should not be called equally sized validation.
